rationale: Requested a reproduction of the partition experiment from its saved inputs in a clean copy: the split_configurations case is the strongest consequence in the account (two leaders in the same term with disjoint quorums and divergent committed histories), and it currently rests on a single receipt produced from the harness version that also carries the later fix to an earlier case. Running the fixed experiment's own saved basis again tests whether that outcome reproduces under the same declared conditions, independent of my current draft, and the new receipt will be interpreted against the same four comparisons. No construction is needed and no other record changes in this submission.
